crime: Before lockup, {WITCH_NAME} and her cellmate chose a large book and took turns reading it. The nightly routine steadied her. Sometimes she lay on the lower bunk with the closed book on her chest, making it heavy enough to lull her to sleep.

One quiet night, the binding cracked as they turned a page. She flinched, lay down, and made the book far heavier than usual. Her breathing grew shallow. Her cellmate told her to stop; she returned the book to normal. The girl said no one else knew yet, but at morning unlock she would tell the warden.

By morning the girl was dead in the lower bunk, the book lying flat across her crushed chest, weighing no more than usual. {WITCH_NAME} called the other prisoners and said it had slipped from her upper bunk.

An ordinary book falling that short distance onto a bed could not account for the crushing beneath its whole cover. Its extra weight lasted only while {WITCH_NAME} touched it. The cell had remained locked with only the two of them inside. She had laid the book on her sleeping cellmate, kept her hand on it until its weight killed the girl, then let go.
fields.epitaph: She had always mistaken being held down for being held.
fields.epithet: The Weight of a Quiet Night
execution: An open frame suspended her by the wrists and ankles, with nothing beneath her. It pulled the restraints outward, spreading her limbs until her joints gave way. Her body went still, and the frame kept pulling.

magic.name: Weight Amplification
magic.text: She can make an object heavier by touching it.
